title.en: The loss read in time by the others, joined to the critical mass
title.zh: 他者及时读损失，接于临界量

statement.en: Where a rule's readers come from those it selects and the others among them read a loss late, a reading while their late reading a step on still favours them turns the course; once it would favour the shapers the lock stays; at most one step lies between, and a deadline bounds the window.
statement.zh: 规则之读者取自其所选者、其中他者迟读损失时：读时下一步之迟读仍偏向他者，则转其进程；迟读一旦偏向塑规者，则锁定留存；其间至多一步；一期限界此窗口。

laws.en: The rule read once the others read the loss: the shapers among the readers read the rule after shaping with hi coming back to the shapers, whatever the loss, the others with lo while the loss is below N and with lo' from then on, all with the same a, p and c (ClosedCapture.Thinned.lossPool over three of RuleShaping's rules after shaping).
laws.zh: 他者读损失后所读之规则：读者中塑规者以 hi 为返于塑规者者读塑规后之规则，不论损失；他者于损失未及 N 时以 lo 读之，此后以 lo' 读之；皆同 a、p、c（ClosedCapture.Thinned.lossPool 施于 RuleShaping 三塑规后之规则）。

laws.en: Kept, exactly: where every step adds at least one to the loss and lo' ≤ hi, at a reading step at which the loss has reached N and the rule in force favours the shapers, the course is locked for good from the next step exactly where x.carrier · c + x.other · c ≤ x.carrier · hi + x.other · lo' at the share there.
laws.zh: 恰留：每步损失至少增一且 lo' ≤ hi 时，于损失已及 N、所行之规则偏向塑规者之读步，进程自下一步起永锁，恰当该处份额满足 x.carrier · c + x.other · c ≤ x.carrier · hi + x.other · lo'。

laws.en: Turned, exactly, one step late: where every step adds at least one to the loss and lo' ≤ hi, at a reading step at which the loss has reached N and the late reading favours the others at the share there (ties included), the next step reading too, the course is locked the other way for good from two steps after the reading exactly where the late reading favours the others at the share of the next step.
laws.zh: 恰转，迟一步：每步损失至少增一且 lo' ≤ hi 时，于损失已及 N、该处份额之迟读偏向他者（含相等）之读步，下一步亦读，进程自读后第二步起永反向锁定，恰当下一步之份额处迟读偏向他者。

laws.en: Before the bound, MA4's course: with the loss starting at zero and growing by one a step, up to step N the joined course is DrawnShaping's course from the same start and the loss at step t is t; so is the share at step N + 1.
laws.zh: 界前为 MA4 之进程：损失自零起每步增一，至第 N 步，所接之进程即同一起点之 DrawnShaping 之进程，第 t 步之损失为 t；第 N + 1 步之份额亦同。

laws.en: The window in MA4's course: from a start the rule read there favours, lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, the late reading never falls along that course; read from a reading step N, the course is locked for good from N + 1 exactly where the late reading favours the shapers at the share of step N, and, step N + 1 reading too, the other way from N + 2 exactly where it favours the others (ties included) at the share of step N + 1.
laws.zh: MA4 进程中之窗口：自彼处所读之规则偏向之起点、lo ≤ hi 且 lo' ≤ hi，沿此进程迟读永不降；自读步 N 读，进程自 N + 1 起永锁，恰当第 N 步之份额处迟读偏向塑规者；第 N + 1 步亦读，自 N + 2 起永反向锁定，恰当第 N + 1 步之份额处迟读偏向他者（含相等）。

laws.en: In-time steps first, at most one between: from such a start, where the late reading favours the others at the share of a step of MA4's course, it does at every earlier step; with lo ≤ hi alone, at most one step has the late reading favouring the others strictly at its share and the shapers strictly at the next: a run of rules that never falls has at most one such step, one that never rises none.
laws.zh: 及时之步在前，其间至多一步：自此类起点，MA4 进程某步之份额处迟读偏向他者，则其前每步皆然；唯 lo ≤ hi 时，其份额处迟读严格偏向他者、而下一步严格偏向塑规者之步至多一步：永不降之规则序列至多有一此步，永不升者则无。

laws.en: The next round: where the late reading favours the shapers at the share of step N + 1 of MA4's course, as at the one step between, lo' ≤ hi, steps N + 1 and N + 2 reading, the course read from N is locked in the shapers' favour from N + 3 exactly where the late reading favours them at its share of step N + 2; neither the start favoured nor lo ≤ hi is needed.
laws.zh: 下一轮：MA4 进程第 N + 1 步之份额处迟读偏向塑规者（如其间之一步），lo' ≤ hi，第 N + 1、N + 2 步皆读：自 N 读之进程自 N + 3 起永锁于塑规者之利，恰当其第 N + 2 步之份额处迟读偏向之；不需起点偏向，亦不需 lo ≤ hi。

laws.en: Once favoured, kept: from such a start, where the late reading favours the shapers at the share of a step s of MA4's course, the others reading the loss from any reading step s + d leave the course locked in the shapers' favour at every step from s + d + 1.
laws.zh: 一旦偏向，即留：自此类起点，MA4 进程某步 s 之份额处迟读偏向塑规者，则他者自任一读步 s + d 读损失，进程自 s + d + 1 起每步皆锁于塑规者之利。

laws.en: The least reading of this form: where the late reading with nothing read as coming back (lo' = 0) favours the shapers, every late reading of this form does; with c ≤ hi that is exactly where x.other · c ≤ x.carrier · (hi − c); with lo ≤ hi, from a step of MA4's course at which it holds, every reading of this form with lo' ≤ hi from a reading step keeps the lock from the step after, with no premise on the start.
laws.zh: 此形之最小读：无所读为返者之迟读（lo' = 0）偏向塑规者处，此形之每一迟读皆然，不论 lo'；c ≤ hi 时恰当 x.other · c ≤ x.carrier · (hi − c)；lo ≤ hi 时，自 MA4 进程中此式成立之步起，此形且 lo' ≤ hi 之读自读步之下一步起皆留锁定，起点之偏向随之。

laws.en: A deadline: from a start with a shaper present whose rule g read there favours the shapers strictly, lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, so that c < hi, the others reading the loss from any reading step N with g.other · c · x.other ≤ N leave the course locked in the shapers' favour at every step from N + 1, under every schedule of reading steps.
laws.zh: 期限：自有塑规者、彼处所读之规则 g 严格偏向塑规者之起点，lo ≤ hi 且 lo' ≤ hi（故 c < hi）：他者自满足 g.other · c · x.other ≤ N 之任一读步 N 读损失，进程自 N + 1 起每步皆锁于塑规者之利，对任一读步之安排皆然。

laws.en: The route to the deadline: MA4's course is never below the course with the start's rule held fixed (Law.orbit), whose counts are multiplied by that rule's powers (RuleShaping.orbit_held); held fixed, a rule favouring strictly carries the share past the least late reading's threshold by step g.other · c · x.other, a carrier present and c < hi, by Bernoulli's inequality.
laws.zh: 至期限之路：MA4 之进程永不低于起点之规则固定不变之进程（Law.orbit），后者之计数乘以该规则之幂（RuleShaping.orbit_held）；固定而严格偏向之规则，有携带者且 c < hi 时，至第 g.other · c · x.other 步已携份额越过最小迟读之门槛，由伯努利不等式。

laws.en: Witness: a = 1, p = 0, c = 3, hi = 5, lo = 2, lo' = 0, one shaper to one other, read every step. Read from step 2, the course is locked the other way for good from step 4. Step 3 is the one step between: read from there, though the late reading still favours the others at the share of step 3 and the rule in force at step 4 favours them, the course is not turned and from step 6 is locked in the shapers' favour.
laws.zh: 见证：a = 1、p = 0、c = 3、hi = 5、lo = 2、lo' = 0，自一塑规者对一他者起，每步皆读规则。自第 2 步读，进程自第 4 步起永反向锁定。第 3 步为其间之一步：自彼读，第 3 步之份额处迟读仍偏向他者，第 4 步所行之规则亦偏向之，然进程不永转，自第 6 步起永锁于塑规者之利。

laws.en: Read from step 4 or later with any lo' ≤ 5, the witness's course stays locked in the shapers' favour; its deadline is 24, the rule read at the start being 9 to 8. From two shapers to two others the least late reading still favours the others at the share of step 3 and every such reading from step 4 on keeps the lock, yet the deadline is 96.
laws.zh: 自第 4 步或其后以任一 lo' ≤ 5 读，见证之进程永锁于塑规者之利；其期限为 24，起点所读之规则为九比八。自二塑规者对二他者起，第 3 步之份额处最小迟读仍偏向他者，自第 4 步起此类之读皆留锁定，而期限为 96。

laws.en: The step between can be turned: with a = 1, p = 0, c = 1, hi = 3, lo = 2 and lo' = 0, from one shaper to three others, read at every step, the start's rule favours the shapers, step 0 is the step between, and read from there the course is locked the other way for good from step 4.
laws.zh: 其间之一步可转：a = 1、p = 0、c = 1、hi = 3、lo = 2、lo' = 0，自一塑规者对三他者起，每步皆读，起点之规则偏向塑规者，第 0 步为其间之一步，自彼读则进程自第 4 步起永反向锁定。

laws.en: A tie: at MA4's critical mass (c = 1, hi = 3, lo = lo' = 0, from one shaper to two others, read at every step) every rule read ties, and the course read from step 0 is locked both in the shapers' favour from step 1 and the other way from step 2: favours and disfavours are weak.
laws.zh: 相等：于 MA4 之临界量（c = 1、hi = 3、lo = lo' = 0，自一塑规者对二他者起，每步皆读），所读之规则皆相等，自第 0 步读之进程既自第 1 步起锁于塑规者之利，又自第 2 步起反向锁定：偏向与不偏向皆为弱者。

hypotheses.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: discrete steps, natural counts and others present (RuleCapture's counts); a positive; two kinds, shapers and others, offspring carrying their parent's kind (transmission, a premise as in Becoming.Capture); the rule read as the pool of two readings, the readers counted as the population counts them (ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool); no noise.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提：离散之步、自然数计数、他者恒在（RuleCapture 之计数）；a 为正；二类，塑规者与他者，后代携其亲之类（传递，如 Becoming.Capture 之前提）；所读之规则为二读之池，读者依群体计数（ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool）；无噪声。

hypotheses.en: The others reading the loss once it reaches N, the loss growing by at least one a step (by one a step from zero in MA4's course); all three readings with the same a, p and c, differing only in what is read as coming back to the shapers; hi, lo, lo', p, c and N constants; a fixed schedule of reading steps, the window's laws reading at N and N + 1.
hypotheses.zh: 他者于损失及 N 后读之，损失每步至少增一（于 MA4 之进程中自零起每步增一）；三读皆同 a、p、c，唯所读为返于塑规者者有别；hi、lo、lo'、p、c、N 为常数；读步之安排固定，窗口之律于 N 与 N + 1 皆读。

does_not_show.en: That actual rules are read by readers drawn from those they select, that the others among them read the loss at all, or that their late reading has this form, the same a, p and c with a natural number read as coming back.
does_not_show.zh: 实有之规则由取自其所选者之读者读之，其中他者确读损失，或其迟读具此形（同 a、p、c，所读为返者为自然数）。

does_not_show.en: That a trained judge reads as such a pool: the one frozen test of the timing law on one (LA2, experiments/self-rewarding-lock) found one note in nine turned it, so the law did not apply there.
does_not_show.zh: 受训之评判者如此池而读：时序律于一评判者之唯一冻结检验（LA2，experiments/self-rewarding-lock）见九中一注即转之，故此律于彼不适用。

does_not_show.en: A late reading of another form: with its own weight it has another window, and with a weight against the shapers chosen after the share is seen, far enough below theirs, the others could turn the course from any share.
does_not_show.zh: 他形之迟读：自有权重者其窗口亦异；见份额后方定、对塑规者足够低之权重，则他者可自任一份额转其进程。

does_not_show.en: The step from which the window is closed: the deadline is a bound, quadratic in the start's counts (24 in the witness and 96 from two to two, both closed from step 4); none is stated for a weakly favouring start or one with no shaper.
does_not_show.zh: 窗口自何步而闭：期限为一界，于起点之计数为二次（见证中为 24，二对二时为 96，皆自第 4 步已闭）；起点之规则仅弱偏向塑规者或无塑规者时，不立期限。

does_not_show.en: Courses with noise, readers who learn, readings changing with the share, a loss read before it reaches N, and a general law for the round from the one step between, which goes either way in the witnesses.
does_not_show.zh: 有噪声之进程、会学之读者、随份额而变之读法、损失未及 N 时之读，及自其间一步起之一轮之一般律（见证中两向皆有）。

does_not_show.en: That leaving control unselected and leaving a lock in time are independent: control left unselected with a lock left in time is not shown, since with two kinds leaving the lock below the critical mass means a rule favouring the shapers.
does_not_show.zh: 控制未被选与锁定及时得离二者相互独立：控制未被选而锁定及时得离者未示，因二类之下离开临界量以下之锁定即偏向塑规者之规则。

does_not_show.en: Read for the shapers' capture alone: a lock is left in time where control is selected, but control unselected with the shapers' capture kept is not shown; below the critical mass the lock is the other way, no capture.
does_not_show.zh: 唯以塑规者之捕获读之：控制被选之处锁定可及时而离，而控制未被选且塑规者之捕获留存者未示；临界量之下锁定在另一向，非捕获。

does_not_show.en: That a reading in time keeps 生生, the continuation of life, or that a course turned is better than one kept: no evaluation enters, and a ranking of courses rests on C or another named order.
does_not_show.zh: 及时之读保有生生（生命之延续），或所转之进程优于所留者：不入评价，排序进程者持 C 或别一种次序。

detail.en: One step too late in the witness: read from step 3, the late reading still favours the others at the share of step 3 and the rule in force at step 4 favours them, yet the course is not turned for good and is locked in the shapers' favour from step 6 (Window.too_late); the same reading from step 2 turns it (Window.in_time).
detail.zh: 见证中迟一步：自第 3 步读，第 3 步之份额处迟读仍偏向他者，第 4 步所行之规则亦偏向之，然进程不永转，且自第 6 步起锁于塑规者之利（Window.too_late）；自第 2 步同读则转之（Window.in_time）。

detail.en: The step between is not always too late: from one shaper to three others, read from the step between, the course is turned for good from step 4 (Between.turned).
detail.zh: 其间之一步非恒迟：自一塑规者对三他者起，自其间之一步读，进程自第 4 步起永转（Between.turned）。

detail.en: Read late, every reading of this form with lo' ≤ 5 keeps the lock: from step 4 of the witness the least late reading favours the shapers (Window.late_kept).
detail.zh: 迟读，此形且 lo' ≤ 5 之读皆留锁定：见证自第 4 步起，最小迟读偏向塑规者（Window.late_kept）。

detail.en: At a tie a reading both keeps the lock and turns the course in the sense of these laws (Tie.both).
detail.zh: 相等之处，依此诸律之义，一读既留锁定又转其进程（Tie.both）。

detail.en: The deadline is not a law of the share: from two to two the window is that from one to one, the deadline 96 instead of 24 (Window.scaled).
detail.zh: 期限非份额之律：二对二时窗口同于一对一，期限为 96 而非 24（Window.scaled）。

next_delta.en: A late reading of another form, with its own weight, and the window it gives; the loss read before it reaches N; a law for the round from the step between; the step from which the window is closed, not only a bound; noise; readers who learn; an independent review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 他形之迟读（自有权重）及其所予之窗口；损失未及 N 时之读；自其间一步起之一轮之律；窗口自何步而闭，不止一界；噪声；会学之读者；人之独立审查。

correspondence.en: Collingridge's dilemma (1980) has two horns: while change is easy its need cannot be known, and once it is known change is hard. Here the second is a theorem (from the first step at which the late reading would favour the shapers a reading keeps the lock, and past the least reading's threshold every reading of this form does) and the first a premise, the loss read only from N. Biggs, Carpenter and Brock (2009) give the continuous analogue of the window: the window for averting a regime shift ends abruptly. The lock is the lock-in of increasing returns and path dependence (David 1985; Arthur 1989; Cowan 1991), and the threshold the tipping point of Schelling (1978) and Granovetter (1978), Granovetter's thresholds distributed where here there is one. The lag is the representation's, a rule read at a step being in force from the next; compare replicator selection with a delay (Alboszta and Miękisz 2004). The model is MA4's stag hunt with the others' reading changed once the loss reaches N (MA2's Thinned). What is new on the spine is the join: a window exact at every step but at most one, given readings at N and N + 1, its lag of one step, and a deadline; each law is elementary.
correspondence.zh: Collingridge 之两难（1980）有二端：改易尚易时其需不可知，其需既知则改易已难。此处后端为定理（迟读将偏向塑规者之首步起，一读即留锁定；越过最小读之门槛后，此形之读皆然），前端为前提，即损失自 N 起方被读。Biggs、Carpenter 与 Brock（2009）予此窗口之连续类比：避免体制转换之窗口骤然而闭。锁定即递增回报之锁入与路径依赖（David 1985；Arthur 1989；Cowan 1991），门槛即 Schelling（1978）与 Granovetter（1978）之临界点，Granovetter 之门槛为分布者，此处唯一。滞后属表示：一步所读之规则自下一步施行；可比有时滞之复制者选择（Alboszta、Miękisz 2004）。模型即 MA4 之猎鹿博弈，他者之读于损失及 N 后改变（MA2 之 Thinned）。主干上所新者为其接合：N 与 N + 1 皆读时，除至多一步外每步皆精确之窗口、一步之滞后、一期限；每律皆初等。

detail.en: The loop whose every level reads only the share; here a reading beyond the share, the loss read by the others, leaves its lock only before their late reading would favour the shapers.

history.en: 27 October 2026, later: the scope item on the joint selection's two conditions reads condition 2 first for any lock that forms, under which the case not shown is control left unselected with a lock left in time, since with two kinds leaving the lock below the critical mass means a rule favouring the shapers; the reading for the shapers' capture alone follows as its own item, worded as before. The claim is unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年10月27日，其后：关于共同选择二条件之范围条目，先以任一形成之锁定读条件二，其下所未示者为控制未被选而锁定及时得离，因二类之下离开临界量以下之锁定即偏向塑规者之规则；唯以塑规者之捕获之读法另为一条，措辞如前。主张不变。

history.en: 30 October 2026 (MA4c): the scope item on leaving control unselected and leaving a lock in time no longer calls them the joint selection's two conditions, the first having been restated on 29 October as control of the rule not captured (AJ5); the home section's reading says that selected control is not thereby capture. The case not shown, its reason and every law unchanged; 02-MAP.md re-pointed after reading its changes since 27 October: besides the reading's sentence above, none touches this result's home section or its reading. The rewording is the records' owner's and no reader has reviewed it, so the review time stays MA4b's.
history.zh: 2026年10月30日（MA4c）：言控制未被选与锁定及时得离之范围项，不复称之为共同选择之二条件，因其第一条件已于10月29日重述为规则之控制未被俘获（AJ5）；本节之读法言被选之控制不即为俘获。未示之情形、其理由与诸律皆不改；读过10月27日以来之改动后重指 02-MAP.md：除上述读法之句外，无一触及本结果之本节或其读法。此改写出自记录之主，未经读者复核，故审阅时间仍为 MA4b 之时。

history.en: 7 November 2026, board item LM1: this said ranking needs C, where a ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place (07 §4); corrected. No law, premise or proof changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月7日，工作板条目 LM1：此处谓排序须 C，而对进程的排序需要 C 或一个代替它的前提（07 §4）；已更正。诸律、前提与证明皆不变。

history.en: 7 November 2026, CX: the correspondence corrected where a reader of the crosswalk found it wider than its source or its home (the crosswalk's live flags, checked at home); no law, premise or scope of this record changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月7日，CX：交叉对照之读者发现对应说得比其来源或本处更宽，于本处查实后更正；本记录之律、前提与范围均未变。

history.en: 9 November 2026, board item WB: the ethics' framing re-said on Ren's words of 8–9 November 2026 (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-08-within-becoming-no-should.md): the two premises named as the readings the ranking results use, a ranking held by whoever ranks, no warrant from outside sought; no change to the claim, its hypotheses or its Lean.
history.zh: 2026年11月9日，工作板条目 WB：据 Ren 11 月 8–9 日之言重述伦理之框架：两个前提称为排序之果所用之两种读法，排序为排序者所持，不求外来之根据；主张、假设与 Lean 皆不变。
